revealed.name: Anvilbrock
revealed.desc: A honey badger with a red-hot anvil for a back; it headbutts you and the anvil rings. Fearless and grumpy; picks fights it cannot win and wins them.

revealed.name: Bubblisk
revealed.desc: A lizard that blows a soap-bubble copy of itself and runs while you pop the bubble. A show-off that startles easily; runs first, poses later.

revealed.name: Cairnback
revealed.desc: A tortoise with an ibex's sweeping horns, carrying a little rune-carved cairn on its shell. Hatched from the Stone Colossus's egg.

revealed.name: Chuggamus
revealed.desc: A hippo that is half steam engine: smokestack ears, a boiler belly, a cowcatcher jaw, and it charges like a runaway train. Lazy until crossed, then unstoppable; yawns steam at you to say it likes you.

revealed.name: Crofthorn
revealed.desc: A highland cow with a walled garden on its back; you ride sitting on the garden wall. Gentle and stubborn, grazes mid-fight; bellows proudly when you climb on.

revealed.name: Gloamshell
revealed.desc: A snail whose shell is smoked obsidian glass. It drinks the light around it and leaves a trail of dusk behind.

revealed.name: Glomwort
revealed.desc: A yellow slime mold that creeps like a net and fruits little puffballs. Step on one and the spores hold you fast.

revealed.name: Hivara
revealed.desc: A honeybee with a praying mantis's folded blades, wearing a crown of wax. A swarm of tiny bees follows it everywhere. Hatched from the Brood Mother's egg.

revealed.name: Lunowl
revealed.desc: A moonlit owl with soft moth wings. It flits on moondust and dazzles foes with silver light.

revealed.name: Marchleaf
revealed.desc: A leafcutter ant hauling a leaf ten times its size, with a column of tiny workers marching behind. It never stops working.

revealed.name: Murmurling
revealed.desc: A starling with pan-pipes for a tail; every note it plays flies off as another tiny bird. Sociable, noisy, lonely in a second; mimics your footsteps.

revealed.name: Nettlynx
revealed.desc: A lynx kitten whose ear tufts and tail are stinging nettle. Pet it the wrong way and you'll know.

revealed.name: Rampartoad
revealed.desc: A toad with a castle wall on its back; sit behind it and nothing gets through, and it pulls stones out of itself to throw. Placid, heavy, a creature of habit; croaks once, deeply, when it disapproves.

revealed.name: Thrumbird
revealed.desc: A hummingbird whose forked tail rings like a tuning fork. Its hum steadies your aim and rattles your foes.

revealed.name: Zephyrak
revealed.desc: A little sky serpent: a moray eel's long body with a swift's swept wings, crackling with static. Hatched from Stormcoil's egg.

revealed.name: Barokat
revealed.desc: A meerkat with a barometer in its belly; when the needle spins, lightning is coming and so is the enemy. Alert and bossy; cannot relax unless it is the one keeping watch.

revealed.name: Barrelmander
revealed.desc: A giant salamander with a rain barrel strapped on its back; your loot goes in the barrel, and a hard hit bursts it in a flash flood. Lazy and good-natured, dozes in puddles; comes alive in a storm.

revealed.name: Bellowary
revealed.desc: A cassowary whose head crest is a leather bellows; every stride pumps it and it blasts a gust of embers. Proud and territorial, loyal to its rider; wheezes the bellows as a warning before it charges.

revealed.name: Boltstrich
revealed.desc: A thundercloud ostrich in rubber boots; ride it and your hair stands up. Skittish and fast, afraid of nothing but boredom; races anything that moves.

revealed.name: Canvastross
revealed.desc: An albatross with patched ship sails for wings; grab the rigging under it and it carries you across the gap. Easygoing, fearless, a wanderer; restless when it has not seen the sea.

revealed.name: Echolop
revealed.desc: A long-eared hare with bat wings. It hears everything coming and fires ringing pulses of sound.

revealed.name: Effigeetle
revealed.desc: A beetle the size of a cart whose shell is a marble statue's face; it splits open down the nose when it flies you across the gap. Earnest and hard-working, a gentle giant; polishes its face when it is proud of you.

revealed.name: Ermink
revealed.desc: A stoat whose tail is a calligraphy brush, its cream coat as blank as a fresh page. Dip its tail in an Ink and it becomes something new.

revealed.name: Frigatee
revealed.desc: A manatee carrying an old icebox on its back; your loot stays cold in its drawers until someone kicks them open. Kind and slow, everyone's friend; hums low songs you feel through your boots.

revealed.name: Glintmole
revealed.desc: A star-nosed mole whose back is a split geode full of quartz. It feels the ground shake long before you do.

revealed.name: Gongibbon
revealed.desc: A gibbon whose belly is a temple bell; it swings by its arms and clangs itself to stun everyone. Loud, joyful, a show-off; sings when happy and louder when scared.

revealed.name: Gravadillo
revealed.desc: An armadillo with a rhino beetle's horn. It rolls up in heavy plates and bends gravity to slam foes down.

revealed.name: Kestrike
revealed.desc: A kestrel with a copper crest that draws lightning. It hangs still in the wind, then strikes like the bolt it caught.

revealed.name: Kindlewren
revealed.desc: A cocky little wren that carries a live coal in its cocked-up tail. It darts in, scorches, and is gone.

revealed.name: Knotwyrm
revealed.desc: A rope snake with mushroom caps growing from its knots; lay it across a path and whoever steps over it gets rooted. Quiet, thoughtful, an old soul; likes damp shade and long naps.

revealed.name: Lanterloris
revealed.desc: A slow loris that is a paper lantern: its belly glows, and when it is scared it floats up like a balloon. Soft-spoken, sleepy by day, wide awake at night; clings to you when frightened.

revealed.name: Lockatara
revealed.desc: A lizard with a padlock shackle for a crest and a keyhole for a third eye; its tail is the key. Ancient, calm, faintly amused; watches you through the keyhole when you are not looking.

revealed.name: Mirrolin
revealed.desc: A pangolin covered in mirror tiles; curl it up and it is a disco ball that bounces every shot back. Timid but stubborn; curls up when spoken to sharply, unrolls for snacks.

revealed.name: Mossgrade
revealed.desc: A plump water bear wearing a cushion of moss. Dry it out and it curls into a pebble; one drop of water and it's back.

revealed.name: Mycroll
revealed.desc: A hedgehog whose quills are glowing toadstools. It puffs spore clouds that root foes where they stand.

revealed.name: Pipewurm
revealed.desc: A velvet-cake worm with icing nozzles for a face; it pipes sticky poison icing that glues your feet down. Looks sweet, hunts like a cat; loves being stroked, hates being ignored.

revealed.name: Prismander
revealed.desc: An axolotl whose frills grew into living crystal. It bends light into shields and dazzling beams.

revealed.name: Prowyak
revealed.desc: A yak with an icebreaker's iron prow for horns; it ploughs through the snow and anything standing in it. Steady and warm-hearted; snorts frost when it laughs.

revealed.name: Rimeshrew
revealed.desc: A tiny shrew with a frost-feathered coat that never melts. It has to eat every hour, so it never stops moving.

revealed.name: Selenfin
revealed.desc: A silver hatchetfish that swims through the air, a moonstone glowing in its keel. Where it floats, wounds close.

revealed.name: Skateron
revealed.desc: A heron on ice skates with an ice-pick beak; it glides in, stabs, glides out. Patient, severe, says little; approves of you only when you stand still.

revealed.name: Snuffapi
revealed.desc: An okapi with a candelabra for horns; snuff the candles and it is gone, leaving a smoke copy behind. Shy and graceful, vanishes when strangers come; trusts one rider and only one.

revealed.name: Soakybara
revealed.desc: A capybara with a hot spring on its back; you ride sitting in the bath, and the steam heals the squad. Calm and sociable, the friend of everything; nothing ruffles it.

revealed.name: Spirevark
revealed.desc: An aardvark with a termite cathedral on its back; climb the spire and shoot from the belfry. Easy-going and nosy; talks to its termites more than to you.

revealed.name: Umbrathere
revealed.desc: A giant ground sloth with a ragged umbrella for a back; it opens it and your whole squad disappears underneath. Brooding and protective; shelters smaller Boki under its arms when it rains.

revealed.name: Vespyx
revealed.desc: A sly fox with a scorpion's curled tail. Its sting drips venom that keeps eating at foes after the hit.

revealed.name: Zippelith
revealed.desc: A worm that unzips the ground: it dives into a seam, zips it shut behind it, and comes up somewhere else. Secretive and sly; loves surprises, appears where you least expect it, grinning.
